audience: training managers who assign courses and track progress in SkyPrep

useCases.title: Find learners who have not finished a course
useCases.text: List the courses to get their ids, then read course progress filtered by course and by status.

useCases.title: Check one learner's courses
useCases.text: Read one user's profile by email, then list the courses they are enrolled in and the status of each.

useCases.title: Review user groups and learning paths
useCases.text: List the user groups with their members, and the learning paths in the account.

useCases.title: Add a learner and enroll them
useCases.text: Create a learner, then enroll the learner in a course or add them to a user group. Admin accounts cannot be created here.
